import type { Clock } from '../../lib/clock';

export interface LruCache<K, V> {
  get(key: K): V | undefined;
  set(key: K, value: V): void;
  has(key: K): boolean;
  readonly size: number;
}

export const createLruCache = <K, V>(
  capacity: number,
  ttlMs: number,
  clock: Clock
): LruCache<K, V> => {
  const store = new Map<K, { value: V; insertedAt: number; accessedAt: number }>();

  const isExpired = (entry: { insertedAt: number; accessedAt: number }): boolean => {
    return clock.now() >= entry.insertedAt + ttlMs;
  };

  const refreshRecency = (key: K): void => {
    const entry = store.get(key);
    if (entry) {
      store.delete(key);
      store.set(key, { ...entry, accessedAt: clock.now() });
    }
  };

  const evictIfNeeded = (): void => {
    if (store.size >= capacity) {
      // Find and remove the oldest non-expired entry
      const entries = Array.from(store.entries());
      for (const [key, entry] of entries) {
        if (!isExpired(entry)) {
          store.delete(key);
          return;
        }
      }
      // If all expired, just clear and return
      store.clear();
    }
  };

  return {
    get: (key: K): V | undefined => {
      const entry = store.get(key);
      if (!entry || isExpired(entry)) {
        store.delete(key);
        return undefined;
      }
      refreshRecency(key);
      return entry.value;
    },

    set: (key: K, value: V): void => {
      const existing = store.get(key);
      if (existing) {
        // Update existing entry
        store.delete(key);
        store.set(key, { value, insertedAt: existing.insertedAt, accessedAt: clock.now() });
      } else {
        evictIfNeeded();
        store.set(key, { value, insertedAt: clock.now(), accessedAt: clock.now() });
      }
    },

    has: (key: K): boolean => {
      const entry = store.get(key);
      if (!entry || isExpired(entry)) {
        if (entry) store.delete(key);
        return false;
      }
      refreshRecency(key);
      return true;
    },

    get size(): number {
      // Count non-expired entries
      let count = 0;
      for (const entry of store.values()) {
        if (!isExpired(entry)) count++;
      }
      return count;
    },
  };
};

  readonly size: number;

  capacity: number,
  ttlMs: number,
  clock: Clock
): LruCache<K, V> => {
  const store = new Map<K, { value: V; insertedAt: number; accessedAt: number }>();

  const isExpired = (entry: { insertedAt: number; accessedAt: number }): boolean => {
    return clock.now() >= entry.insertedAt + ttlMs;

  const refreshRecency = (key: K): void => {
    const entry = store.get(key);
    if (entry) {
      store.delete(key);
      store.set(key, { ...entry, accessedAt: clock.now() });
    }
  };

  const evictIfNeeded = (): void => {
    if (store.size < capacity) return;

    const liveEntries: [K, { value: V; insertedAt: number; accessedAt: number }][] = [];
    for (const [key, entry] of store) {
      if (!isExpired(entry)) {
        liveEntries.push([key, entry]);
      }

    if (liveEntries.length === 0) {
      store.clear();
      return;
    }

    liveEntries.sort((a, b) => a[1].accessedAt - b[1].accessedAt);
    store.delete(liveEntries[0][0]);
  };

  return {
    get: (key: K): V | undefined => {
      const entry = store.get(key);
      if (!entry || isExpired(entry)) {
        store.delete(key);
        return undefined;
      }
      refreshRecency(key);
      return entry.value;
    },

    set: (key: K, value: V): void => {
      const existing = store.get(key);
      if (existing) {
        store.delete(key);
        store.set(key, { value, insertedAt: existing.insertedAt, accessedAt: clock.now() });
      } else {
        evictIfNeeded();
        store.set(key, { value, insertedAt: clock.now(), accessedAt: clock.now() });
      }
    },

    has: (key: K): boolean => {
      const entry = store.get(key);
      if (!entry || isExpired(entry)) {
        if (entry) store.delete(key);
        return false;
      }
      refreshRecency(key);
      return true;
    },

    get size(): number {
      let count = 0;
      for (const entry of store.values()) {
        if (!isExpired(entry)) count++;
      }
      return count;
    },
  };
};

  get(key: string, compute: () => Promise<number>): Promise<number>;

  readonly value: number;
  readonly expiresAt: number;
}

  const entries = new Map<string, CacheEntry>();
  const inFlight = new Map<string, Promise<number>>();

  return {
    async get(key: string, compute: () => Promise<number>): Promise<number> {
      const hit = entries.get(key);
      if (hit !== undefined && hit.expiresAt > clock.now()) {
        return hit.value;
      }

      const pending = inFlight.get(key);
      if (pending !== undefined) {
        return pending;
      }

      const computation = (async (): Promise<number> => {
        try {
          const value = await compute();
          entries.set(key, { value, expiresAt: clock.now() + ttlMs });
          return value;
        } finally {
          inFlight.delete(key);
        }
      })();

import type { Clock } from '../../lib/clock';

interface CacheEntry<V> {
  readonly value: V;
  readonly insertedAt: number;
  readonly lastAccessedAt: number;
}

export interface LruCache<K, V> {
  get(key: K): V | undefined;
  set(key: K, value: V): void;
  has(key: K): boolean;
  readonly size: number;
}

const isExpired = <V>(entry: CacheEntry<V>, now: number, ttlMs: number): boolean =>
  now >= entry.insertedAt + ttlMs;

const evictLeastRecent = <K, V>(
  store: Map<K, CacheEntry<V>>,
  capacity: number,
  clock: Clock,
  ttlMs: number
): void => {
  if (store.size <= capacity) return;
  let oldestKey: K | undefined;
  let oldestTime = Infinity;
  const now = clock.now();
  for (const [key, entry] of store) {
    if (!isExpired(entry, now, ttlMs) && entry.lastAccessedAt < oldestTime) {
      oldestTime = entry.lastAccessedAt;
      oldestKey = key;
    }
  }
  if (oldestKey !== undefined) {
    store.delete(oldestKey);
  }
};

const getLiveEntry = <K, V>(
  store: Map<K, CacheEntry<V>>,
  key: K,
  clock: Clock,
  ttlMs: number
): CacheEntry<V> | undefined => {
  const entry = store.get(key);
  if (entry === undefined) return undefined;
  const now = clock.now();
  if (isExpired(entry, now, ttlMs)) {
    store.delete(key);
    return undefined;
  }
  return entry;
};

const refreshRecency = <K, V>(
  store: Map<K, CacheEntry<V>>,
  key: K,
  clock: Clock
): void => {
  const entry = store.get(key);
  if (entry !== undefined) {
    store.set(key, { ...entry, lastAccessedAt: clock.now() });
  }
};

const countLiveEntries = <K, V>(
  store: Map<K, CacheEntry<V>>,
  clock: Clock,
  ttlMs: number
): number => {
  const now = clock.now();
  let count = 0;
  for (const entry of store.values()) {
    if (!isExpired(entry, now, ttlMs)) count++;
  }
  return count;
};

export const createLruCache = <K, V>(
  capacity: number,
  ttlMs: number,
  clock: Clock
): LruCache<K, V> => {
  const store = new Map<K, CacheEntry<V>>();
  return {
    get: (key: K): V | undefined => {
      const entry = getLiveEntry(store, key, clock, ttlMs);
      if (entry === undefined) return undefined;
      refreshRecency(store, key, clock);
      return entry.value;
    },
    set: (key: K, value: V): void => {
      const now = clock.now();
      store.set(key, { value, insertedAt: now, lastAccessedAt: now });
      evictLeastRecent(store, capacity, clock, ttlMs);
    },
    has: (key: K): boolean => getLiveEntry(store, key, clock, ttlMs) !== undefined,
    get size(): number {
      return countLiveEntries(store, clock, ttlMs);
    },
  };

import type { Clock } from '../../lib/clock';

interface CacheEntry<V> {
  value: V;
  insertedAt: number;
  lastAccessedAt: number;
}

export interface LruCache<K, V> {
  get(key: K): V | undefined;
  set(key: K, value: V): void;
  has(key: K): boolean;
  readonly size: number;
}

const isExpired = <V>(entry: CacheEntry<V>, now: number, ttlMs: number): boolean =>
  now >= entry.insertedAt + ttlMs;

const purgeExpired = <K, V>(
  store: Map<K, CacheEntry<V>>,
  now: number,
  ttlMs: number
): void => {
  for (const [key, entry] of store) {
    if (isExpired(entry, now, ttlMs)) {
      store.delete(key);
    }
  }
};

const evictLeastRecent = <K, V>(store: Map<K, CacheEntry<V>>): void => {
  let oldestKey: K | undefined;
  let oldestAccess = Infinity;
  for (const [key, entry] of store) {
    if (entry.lastAccessedAt < oldestAccess) {
      oldestAccess = entry.lastAccessedAt;
      oldestKey = key;
    }
  }
  if (oldestKey !== undefined) {
    store.delete(oldestKey);
  }
};

export function createLruCache<K, V>(
  capacity: number,
  ttlMs: number,
  clock: Clock
): LruCache<K, V> {
  const store = new Map<K, CacheEntry<V>>();

  return {
    get(key: K): V | undefined {
      const entry = store.get(key);
      if (entry === undefined) return undefined;
      const now = clock.now();
      if (isExpired(entry, now, ttlMs)) {
        store.delete(key);
        return undefined;
      }
      entry.lastAccessedAt = now;
      return entry.value;
    },

    set(key: K, value: V): void {
      const now = clock.now();
      const existing = store.get(key);
      if (existing !== undefined) {
        existing.value = value;
        existing.lastAccessedAt = now;
        return;
      }
      if (store.size >= capacity) {
        purgeExpired(store, now, ttlMs);
        if (store.size >= capacity) {
          evictLeastRecent(store);
        }
      }
      store.set(key, { value, insertedAt: now, lastAccessedAt: now });
    },

    has(key: K): boolean {
      const entry = store.get(key);
      if (entry === undefined) return false;
      const now = clock.now();
      if (isExpired(entry, now, ttlMs)) {
        store.delete(key);
        return false;
      }
      return true;
    },

    get size(): number {
      const now = clock.now();
      purgeExpired(store, now, ttlMs);
      return store.size;
    },
  };
}

interface BucketState {
  readonly tokens: number;
  readonly lastRefillAt: number;

      buckets.set(key, state);

    return false;
  };

function tokenize(input: string): Result<Token[]> {
  const tokens: Token[] = [];
  let i = 0;
  while (i < input.length) {
    const ch = input[i];
    if (ch === ' ' || ch === '\t') { i++; continue; }
    if (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
      let num = '';
      while (i < input.length && input[i] >= '0' && input[i] <= '9') {
        num += input[i]; i++;
      }
      tokens.push({ kind: 'num', value: Number(num) }); continue;
    }
    if (ch === '+' || ch === '-' || ch === '*' || ch === '/') {
      tokens.push({ kind: 'op', value: ch }); i++; continue;
    }
    if (ch === '(') { tokens.push({ kind: 'lparen' }); i++; continue; }
    if (ch === ')') { tokens.push({ kind: 'rparen' }); i++; continue; }
    return { ok: false, error: `Unexpected character: ${ch}` };
  }
  return { ok: true, value: tokens };
}

function parseExpr(tokens: readonly Token[], cursor: { pos: number }): Result<number> {
  let left = parseTerm(tokens, cursor);
  if (!left.ok) return left;
  while (cursor.pos < tokens.length) {
    const t = tokens[cursor.pos];
    if (t.kind !== 'op' || (t.value !== '+' && t.value !== '-')) break;
    cursor.pos++;
    const right = parseTerm(tokens, cursor);
    if (!right.ok) return right;
    left = { ok: true, value: t.value === '+' ? left.value + right.value : left.value - right.value };
  }
  return left;
}

function parseTerm(tokens: readonly Token[], cursor: { pos: number }): Result<number> {
  let left = parseFactor(tokens, cursor);
  if (!left.ok) return left;
  while (cursor.pos < tokens.length) {
    const t = tokens[cursor.pos];
    if (t.kind !== 'op' || (t.value !== '*' && t.value !== '/')) break;
    cursor.pos++;
    const right = parseFactor(tokens, cursor);
    if (!right.ok) return right;
    if (right.value === 0) return { ok: false, error: 'Division by zero' };
    left = { ok: true, value: t.value === '*' ? left.value * right.value : left.value / right.value };
  }
  return left;
}

function parseFactor(tokens: readonly Token[], cursor: { pos: number }): Result<number> {
  if (cursor.pos >= tokens.length) {
    return { ok: false, error: 'Unexpected end of expression' };
  }
  const t = tokens[cursor.pos];
  if (t.kind === 'num') {
    cursor.pos++;
    return { ok: true, value: t.value };
  }
  if (t.kind === 'lparen') {
    cursor.pos++;
    const inner = parseExpr(tokens, cursor);
    if (!inner.ok) return inner;
    if (cursor.pos >= tokens.length || tokens[cursor.pos].kind !== 'rparen') {
      return { ok: false, error: 'Missing closing parenthesis' };
    }
    cursor.pos++;
    return inner;
  }
  return { ok: false, error: `Unexpected token: ${t.kind}` };
}

export function evaluate(expr: string): Result<number> {
  const tok = tokenize(expr);
  if (!tok.ok) return tok;
  const cursor = { pos: 0 };
  const result = parseExpr(tok.value, cursor);
  if (!result.ok) return result;
  if (cursor.pos < tok.value.length) {
    return { ok: false, error: 'Unexpected token after expression' };
  }
  return result;
}

import type { Amount, LineItem } from "./types";

export const PERCENT_BASE = 100;

function pctOf(amount: Amount): number {
  return amount.kind === "percent" ? amount.pct : 0;
}

async function adjustmentOf(base: number, amount: Amount): Promise<number> {
  if (amount.kind === "fixed") {
    return amount.value;

    return (base * pctOf(amount)) / PERCENT_BASE;
  }
  return amount.load();
}

}

export async function computeTotal(items: readonly LineItem[]): Promise<number> {
  let sum = 0;
  for (const item of items) {
    sum += await lineTotal(item);
  }
  return sum;
}

export interface PriceCache {

        try {

          entries.set(key, { value, expiresAt: clock.now() + ttlMs });
          return value;
        } finally {
          pending.delete(key);
        }
      })();

      return promise;
    },
  };
}

import { Clock } from '../lib/clock';

interface CacheEntry<V> {
  readonly value: V;
  readonly insertedAt: number;
}

export interface LruCache<K, V> {
  get(key: K): V | undefined;
  set(key: K, value: V): void;
  has(key: K): boolean;
  readonly size: number;
}

export function createLruCache<K, V>(
  capacity: number,
  ttlMs: number,
  clock: Clock,
): LruCache<K, V> {
  const entries = new Map<K, CacheEntry<V>>();

  const isExpired = (entry: CacheEntry<V>): boolean =>
    clock.now() >= entry.insertedAt + ttlMs;

  const pruneExpired = (): void => {
    for (const [key, entry] of entries.entries()) {
      if (isExpired(entry)) {
        entries.delete(key);
      }
    }
  };

  const getLiveSize = (): number => {
    pruneExpired();
    return entries.size;
  };

  const evictLruLive = (): void => {
    const iterator = entries.keys();
    const oldestKey = iterator.next().value;
    if (oldestKey !== undefined) {
      entries.delete(oldestKey);
    }
  };

  return {
    get(key: K): V | undefined {
      const entry = entries.get(key);
      if (entry === undefined) return undefined;

      if (isExpired(entry)) {
        entries.delete(key);
        return undefined;
      }

      entries.delete(key);
      entries.set(key, entry);
      return entry.value;
    },

    set(key: K, value: V): void {
      entries.delete(key);
      pruneExpired();

      if (getLiveSize() >= capacity) {
        evictLruLive();
      }

      entries.set(key, {
        value,
        insertedAt: clock.now(),
      });
    },

    has(key: K): boolean {
      const entry = entries.get(key);
      if (entry === undefined) return false;

      if (isExpired(entry)) {
        entries.delete(key);
        return false;
      }

      return true;
    },

    get size(): number {
      return getLiveSize();
    },
  };
}

import type { Clock } from '../../lib/clock';

export interface RateLimiter {
  readonly tryAcquire: (key: string, tokens?: number) => boolean;
}

interface Bucket {
  tokens: number;
  lastRefillAt: number;
}

export function createRateLimiter(
  capacity: number,
  refillPerSec: number,
  clock: Clock
): RateLimiter {
  const buckets = new Map<string, Bucket>();

  const getOrInitBucket = (key: string): Bucket => {
    const bucket = buckets.get(key);
    if (bucket !== undefined) {
      return bucket;
    }
    const initial = { tokens: capacity, lastRefillAt: clock.now() };
    buckets.set(key, initial);
    return initial;
  };

  const refill = (bucket: Bucket): void => {
    const now = clock.now();
    const elapsedSeconds = (now - bucket.lastRefillAt) / 1000;
    const refilled = bucket.tokens + elapsedSeconds * refillPerSec;
    bucket.tokens = Math.min(capacity, refilled);
    bucket.lastRefillAt = now;
  };

  return {
    tryAcquire(key: string, tokens = 1): boolean => {
      const bucket = getOrInitBucket(key);
      refill(bucket);
      if (bucket.tokens < tokens) {
        return false;
      }
      bucket.tokens -= tokens;
      return true;
    },
  };
}

  for (let i = 0; i < expr.length; i++) {
    const char = expr[i];
    if (/\s/.test(char)) continue;
    if (/[0-9]/.test(char)) {
      let numStr = '';
      while (i < expr.length && /[0-9]/.test(expr[i])) {
        numStr += expr[i];
        i++;
      }
      i--;
      tokens.push({ type: 'NUMBER', value: parseInt(numStr, 10) });
    } else if (operators[char]) {
      tokens.push({ type: operators[char] });
    } else {
      return { ok: false, error: `Unexpected character: ${char}` };
    }
  }
  return { ok: true, value: tokens as unknown as number }; // result is tokens, cast for Result return
}

// Helper to wrap tokenize Result to provide the actual array
function getTokens(expr: string): Result {
  const res = tokenize(expr);
  if (!res.ok) return res;
  return { ok: true, value: (res.value as unknown as Token[]) as unknown as number };
}

class Parser {
  private tokens: readonly Token[];
  private pos = 0;

  constructor(tokens: readonly Token[]) {
    this.tokens = tokens;
  }

  private peek(): Token | undefined {
    return this.tokens[this.pos];
  }

  private consume(): Token | undefined {
    return this.tokens[this.pos++];
  }

  private parseFactor(): Result {
    const token = this.consume();
    if (!token) return { ok: false, error: 'Unexpected end of expression' };

    if (token.type === 'NUMBER') return { ok: true, value: token.value ?? 0 };
    if (token.type === 'LPAREN') {
      const res = this.parseExpr();
      if (!res.ok) return res;
      const close = this.consume();
      if (!close || close.type !== 'RPAREN') return { ok: false, error: 'Missing closing parenthesis' };
      return res;
    }
    return { ok: false, error: `Unexpected token: ${token.type}` };
  }

  private parseTerm(): Result {
    const left = this.parseFactor();
    if (!left.ok) return left;

    let val = left.value;
    while (this.peek()?.type === 'STAR' || this.peek()?.type === 'SLASH') {
      const op = this.consume()?.type;
      const right = this.parseFactor();
      if (!right.ok) return right;
      if (op === 'STAR') {
        val = val * right.value;
      } else {
        if (right.value === 0) return { ok: false, error: 'Division by zero' };
        val = val / right.value;
      }
    }
    return { ok: true, value: val };
  }

  private parseExpr(): Result {
    const left = this.parseTerm();
    if (!left.ok) return left;

    let val = left.value;
    while (this.peek()?.type === 'PLUS' || this.peek()?.type === 'MINUS') {
      const op = this.consume()?.type;
      const right = this.parseTerm();
      if (!right.ok) return right;
      val = op === 'PLUS' ? val + right.value : val - right.value;
    }
    return { ok: true, value: val };
  }

  public evaluate(): Result {
    const res = this.parseExpr();
    if (!res.ok) return res;
    if (this.pos < this.tokens.length) return { ok: false, error: 'Unexpected trailing tokens' };
    return res;
  }
}

export function evaluate(expr: string): Result {
  const tokenRes = tokenize(expr);
  if (!tokenRes.ok) return tokenRes;
  const parser = new Parser((tokenRes.value as unknown as Token[]) as readonly Token[]);
  return parser.evaluate();
}

export type Amount =
  | { readonly kind: "fixed"; readonly value: number }
  | { readonly kind: "percent"; readonly pct: number }
  | { readonly kind: "deferred"; readonly load: () => Promise<number> };

export interface LineItem {
  readonly id: string;
  readonly base: number;
  readonly adjustment: Amount;
}


// FILE: pricing.ts
import type { Amount, LineItem } from "./types";

export const PERCENT_BASE = 100;

/** Percentage carried by an amount; non-percent amounts contribute no rate. */
function pctOf(amount: Amount): number {
  return amount.kind === "percent" ? amount.pct : 0;
}

async function adjustmentOf(base: number, amount: Amount): Promise<number> {
  if (amount.kind === "fixed") {
    return amount.value;
  }
  if (amount.kind === "deferred") {
    return await amount.load();
  }
  return (base * pctOf(amount)) / PERCENT_BASE;
}

export async function lineTotal(item: LineItem): Promise<number> {
  return item.base + await adjustmentOf(item.base, item.adjustment);
}

export async function computeTotal(items: readonly LineItem[]): Promise<number> {
  const totals = await Promise.all(items.map(lineTotal));
  return totals.reduce((sum, total) => sum + total, 0);
}

import type { Amount, LineItem } from "./types";
import { lineTotal } from "./pricing";

const KIND_LABEL: Partial<Record<Amount["kind"], string>> = {
  fixed: "flat",
  percent: "rate",
  deferred: "deferred",
};
const UNKNOWN_LABEL = "other";

export function amountLabel(amount: Amount): string {
  return KIND_LABEL[amount.kind] ?? UNKNOWN_LABEL;
}

export async function reportLine(item: LineItem): Promise<string> {
  return `${item.id} [${amountLabel(item.adjustment)}]: ${String(await lineTotal(item))}`;
}

export async function buildReport(items: readonly LineItem[]): Promise<readonly string[]> {
  return Promise.all(items.map(reportLine));
}

import type { Clock } from "../../lib/clock";

export interface PriceCache {
  /** Return the cached total for `key` if fresh, else run `compute` and cache its result. */
  get(key: string, compute: () => Promise<number>): Promise<number>;
}

interface CacheEntry {
  readonly value: number;
  readonly expiresAt: number;
}

const DEFAULT_TTL_MS = 60_000;

export function createPriceCache(clock: Clock, ttlMs: number = DEFAULT_TTL_MS): PriceCache {
  const entries = new Map<string, CacheEntry>();
  const flights = new Map<string, Promise<number>>();

  return {
    async get(key: string, compute: () => Promise<number>): Promise<number> {
      const hit = entries.get(key);
      if (hit !== undefined && hit.expiresAt > clock.now()) {
        return hit.value;
      }

      const flight = flights.get(key);
      if (flight !== undefined) {
        return flight;
      }

      const promise = compute().then(value => {
        entries.set(key, { value, expiresAt: clock.now() + ttlMs });
        flights.delete(key);
        return value;
      }).catch(err => {
        flights.delete(key);
        throw err;
      });

      flights.set(key, promise);
      return promise;
    },
  };
}
